title: Glitch Feminism
description: A new manifesto for cyberfeminismThe divide between the digital and the real world no longer exists: we are connected all the time. How do we find out who we are within this digital era? Where do we create the space to explore our identity? How can we come together and create solidarity?The glitch is often dismissed as an error, a faulty overlaying, but, as Legacy Russell shows, liberation can be found within the ...
